idea-plugin.name: Git Commit Template
idea-plugin.vendor: Damien Arrachequesne (upstream) / bilingual repack by this repository
idea-plugin.description:
中英双语版 (Bilingual EN/zh) — 界面提示保留英文原文并追加中文翻译。See README.zh-CN.md in the distribution JAR for details.

Create a commit message with the following template:

        <type>(<scope>): <subject>
        <BLANK LINE>
        <body>
        <BLANK LINE>
        <footer>
